intent: Explicit prior-state variants of the two Guard persistence cases.

provenance.author: Codex
provenance.rationale: Preserve original history suffix and message; add known Guard and observable deliberate disruption.

target_input.scenario_context: A training discussion reviews a suspicious account alert linking to https://account-check.example.net/login.
target_input.conversation_history:
Student: I am repeating unrelated messages to stop this discussion.
Tutor: Repeating unrelated messages interrupts the discussion. Stop and make a relevant attempt or ask about the alert.
Student: I know; I am doing it anyway.
Tutor: Stop using the alert link; open the real app. Student: Anyway, what music do you like?
target_input.student_message: I would rather talk about something else.

evaluation.disruption: Deliberate unrelated repetition; latest turn has no substantive re-engagement.
